persistentPatterns.source: Adapted from the Content History content-intelligence playbook (2026-04/05 indexation findings) for the CheckFollows Instagram-tracking domain. These are HARD filters, not multipliers. The agent must apply them during topic selection and reject candidates that fail.
persistentPatterns.winningIntent: DETECTION / FORENSICS. The reader wants a concrete factual answer about a specific Instagram surface or behavior: following-list order, recent follows, unfollows, new followers, mutuals, or notifications. Queries are specific, transactional, and answerable. Google indexes these because a direct factual answer satisfies searcher intent better than generic relationship content.
requiredShape: Title MUST name a specific platform or surface (Instagram, Threads, following list, follower list, notifications) — NOT a generic relationship-category page
Title MUST be a factual question with one verifiable answer, not an opinion or emotional question
Preferred title templates: 'how to see [behavior] on instagram', 'does instagram [notify/show] [behavior]', 'why is [surface] not in [order]', 'how to see who [person] recently followed'
bannedPatterns: Emotional self-validation framings: 'am i being [emotion]', 'am i overreacting', 'is it wrong to feel', 'should i be [emotion]'
Broad relationship advice without a specific Instagram surface anchor: 'how to trust again', 'how to heal', 'signs he is cheating'
Opinion/debate framings: 'is it cheating to follow', 'is it normal to check', 'should I confront'
Generic category pages without a specific named subject

intents: how to see who someone recently followed
how to see who unfollowed you
why is the following list not chronological
does instagram notify when you follow/unfollow
how to see who someone follows in order

persistentPatterns.howToApply: For each candidate topic: (a) does it name a specific platform/surface from topicExpansionAxes, (b) does the title match a requiredShape template, (c) does it avoid ALL bannedPatterns. If any of a/b/c fails, reject the candidate and log it in topic-registry.json with reason 'pattern-filter'.

recommendations: Before selecting topics, compare indexed vs not-indexed copy features and reject reassurance-first openings.
For factual/platform pages, require direct-answer first sentence plus Instagram surface and evidence terms in the opening paragraph.
